summary: All six quality dimensions pass. No prior findings were raised, so nothing carries forward as unresolved. The three changed paragraphs each introduce or extend links with appropriate hedging: the ISO APG link correctly attributes the source as educational material and not mandatory criteria; the ICC process page link is cited as one source for questions; and the AI-output paragraph correctly attributes the claim to the ICC source and hedges it as a starting point for questions rather than a verified capability. All cited URLs match supplied research source URLs or the permitted internal site path. Claims throughout are supported by the supplied sources and appropriately hedged. The page stays within its assigned introductory scope across all three subsections without encroaching on adjacent chapters. Prose is readable and non-repetitive. No FAQ section appears, which is correct as none is assigned to this introduction chapter. Workflow roles, records, decisions, and the illustrative example are present and consistently labeled hypothetical. Glossary definitions for Process owner, Process boundary, and Handoff appear in context.glossary and are restated in the page body only as inline prose definitions, which is acceptable usage rather than a formal restatement.

Distinguish a condition accepted for a limited scope from a question that still needs evidence before expanding use
